# Cases for the hello-oracle: `<colon-joined-names> <min> <max>` per line, `-` means
# an empty config list (crypto/tls falls back to its default suites). One `CS <hex>`
# output line per case: the raw cipher_suites field (2-byte BE length + suite ids).
# The golden was generated by Go 1.24.6 on an AES-hardware host (arm64); the Rust
# builder is gated on the same hasAESGCMHardwareSupport=true branch. The NoAES
# re-order and TLS 1.3 NoAES array are exercised by a Rust unit test only, named in
# the page, because this host cannot force the non-AES branch through crypto/tls.

# Empty config: crypto/tls defaults (all supported suites, AES order, TLS 1.3 appended).
- 1.2 1.3

# A single CBC suite: the config order and the wire order are both trivial here, but
# it proves an advertise-only suite survives the re-order and TLS 1.3 is appended.
TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA 1.2 1.3

# The reorder witness: two GCM suites fed ECDSA-256 before ECDSA-128, but crypto/tls
# emits them in preference order (ECDSA-128 first), so config order is NOT wire order.
TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 1.2 1.3

# An unknown name is dropped (xray-core keeps only crypto/tls' known names).
TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256:BOGUS_SUITE_NAME 1.2 1.3

# real-firefox-cipherSuites preset, min 1.2 max 1.3.
TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256:TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256:TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA:TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256:TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA:TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA 1.2 1.3

# The same preset at max 1.2: no TLS 1.3 suite is appended.
TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256:TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256:TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA:TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256:TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA:TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA 1.2 1.2

# The same preset pinned to TLS 1.3 only: crypto/tls drops the TLS 1.2 list and
# offers only its three TLS 1.3 suites.
TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256:TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256:TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA:TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256:TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA:TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA 1.3 1.3

# semi-python-cipherSuites preset, min 1.2 max 1.3.
TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256:TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256:TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA:TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256:TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256 1.2 1.3

# CBC-only config with a 1.1 floor: crypto/tls still appends TLS 1.3 up to max 1.3.
TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA:TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256 1.1 1.3

# A max below TLS 1.2 hides the supportedOnlyTLS12 suites (the AES-GCM one) but keeps the
# CBC-with-ECDHE-free ones, and appends no TLS 1.3: the one branch every other case (max 1.2+)
# leaves unwalked. This is crypto/tls' suiteTLS12 gate on the wire.
TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA:TLS_ECDHE_ECDSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 1.0 1.1
